name: Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 7
removable: No (certificate: do not open the case; fitting by Xciel or authorised partner only)
summary: The Xciel XCZ1 iPad mini 7 is a flameproof (Ex d) case for the iPad mini (A17 Pro), certified for Zone 1 under ATEX and IECEx. The tablet inside is a standard iPad mini (A17 Pro) running iPadOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIB T6 Gb
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 1 (2025-01-20), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not verified at source

safety.conditions: Do not open the aluminium case. The iPad shall not be charged, by cable or wireless, when hazardous atmospheres are present; charge only with a suitably approved charger. Flameproof joints shall not be modified or repaired. Fasteners are thread-locked and must not be removed or replaced without the manufacturer's approval; the only fasteners the end user may remove are those of the USB charging port cover and the SIM card cover. Rubber bumpers must be fitted at all times and inspected before each use.
safety.peripherals: USB-C charging port cover and SIM card cover must be fitted in the Ex area (user may remove only their fasteners, outside the Ex area); no cable or wireless charging in a hazardous atmosphere
safety.certifiedAccessories: Accessories are options only: magnet mounting system, locking system, capacitive stylus, ballistic nylon case, carrying handle, hard shell carry case, chest harness, shoulder strap. None is stated to be Ex-rated; the certificate covers the enclosure only.

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least October 2029 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 8.3-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD, P3, True Tone, fully laminated, antireflective coating
specs.camera: 12 MP Wide, f/1.8, True Tone flash
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi (9 hours cellular)
specs.ports: USB-C (USB 3, 10 Gb/s); magnetic Apple Pencil connector
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.network: Wi-Fi only or Wi-Fi + Cellular (5G sub-6 GHz)
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button with Touch ID sensor, volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C); hover
specs.partNumbers: XCZ1MINI7 (case only); XCZ1MINI7-128GB/-256GB/-512GB and -5G variants (via atexshop)
